title: Go 2PC Escrow State Machine: PayPal Orders v2 AUTHORIZE, CAPTURE & VOID
description: Implement the deterministic Two-Phase Commit (2PC) Escrow State Machine in Go binding KYA mandates to PayPal Sandbox Orders v2 AUTHORIZE, Authorizations CAPTURE, and Authorizations VOID.
steps: Implement state transitions: INITIATED -> MANDATE_VERIFIED -> CHANNEL3_BENCHMARKED -> PAYPAL_AUTHORIZED -> SLA_SCHEDULED -> TRACKING_VERIFIED -> PAYPAL_CAPTURED | PAYPAL_VOIDED | DISPUTE_FILED
Wire API-07 (/authorize), API-09 (/capture), and API-10 (/void) with Redis PayPal-Request-Id idempotency locks
Write concurrency-safe unit tests with go test -race
pass: go test -race ./internal/escrow/... passes 100% of state transition tests
Duplicate capture/void requests with the same PayPal-Request-Id return idempotent cached results
